description: Reads research PDFs with page-anchored provenance. Covers DAAF's deterministic pdf_ingest CLI (unaltered poppler text as the quote anchor, a second extractor, page flags, OCR on scanned pages, 2000 px renders), the lit_verify card gate that checks each verbatim quote and number on its cited page, the vision cross-check policy and its dated vision-validated model list, two-column, table and scan handling, and the arXiv HTML lane (section-cited cards). Use whenever an agent must read, quote, or extract numbers, tables or figures from a PDF already on disk: OA papers saved by web_fetch.sh (exit 8), user-supplied papers, codebooks, methodology reports. For research reading it overrides the synced anthropic-skills:pdf, whose pypdf and pip-install recipes DAAF blocks. NOT for finding or downloading papers (scholarly-search, web-retrieval), or creating, merging or filling PDFs.
